headline: You test your open source and not your day job.

gaps.name: Automated testing
gaps.why: Tests sit in 6 of your 34 repos and motion-kit has 31 test files, but your resume lists Vitest and Jest with no testing bullet at work.

evidence.text: Tests in 6 of 34 repos; motion-kit has 31 test files
Vitest and Jest listed; no testing bullet at work
Rebuilt Kitebird checkout in React; owns 42-component Kite UI

moves.title: Put a test suite under Kite UI's checkout components
moves.body: Bring the discipline motion-kit shows to the work you are paid for, where a reviewer can see it.

have.text: You own Kite UI's 42 components and rebuilt checkout

phases.title: Cover the checkout flow
